toggle-button.$description: ToggleButton's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--toggle-button-<name>) on the page, a container or one toggle, and everything inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

text-pressed.$description: Text and icon while pressed (4.5:1 on bg-pressed).

border-pressed.$description: The outline variant's border while pressed (3:1 on surface).
